# Lyra Enterprises

> Lyra Enterprises is an Indian manufacturer of sanitary napkin vending machines and sanitary napkin incinerators, based in Ambattur, Chennai, Tamil Nadu. Products include manual (push-button), coin-operated, multi-coin, RFID, UPI/QR, touchless wave-sensor, WiFi and Ethernet vending machines, and Micro/Mini/Maxi incinerators. Machines are supplied and installed across India, with 200+ installations in schools, colleges, hospitals, offices and public institutions. GeM-registered vendor; ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 14001:2015 quality/environmental management; CPCB and Solid Waste Management Rules 2016 compliant.

## Vending machine models (prices ex-GST, ex-works Chennai)

- [Push Button](https://lyraenterprise.co.in/products/push-button-vending-machine): ₹12,000 — free-vend, offline usage log, 25 napkins
- [Solo Coin](https://lyraenterprise.co.in/products/solo-coin-vending-machine): ₹13,500 — ₹5 coin, no internet, 25 napkins
- [Solo Multi-Coin](https://lyraenterprise.co.in/products/solo-multi-coin-vending-machine): ₹15,500 — ₹1/₹2/₹5 coins, configurable price
- [Solo RFID](https://lyraenterprise.co.in/products/solo-rfid-vending-machine): ₹16,000 — RFID card/tag, prepaid/postpaid, wired network, cloud dashboard
- [Solo QR](https://lyraenterprise.co.in/products/solo-qr-vending-machine): ₹19,500 — UPI QR only, SIM-based, no coin acceptor
- [Solo Wave](https://lyraenterprise.co.in/products/solo-wave-vending-machine): ₹23,000 — touchless wave sensor, stainless steel, up to 35 napkins, free issue
- [Solo WiFi](https://lyraenterprise.co.in/products/solo-wifi-vending-machine): ₹24,500 — UPI QR + ₹5 coin, WiFi, touch display, cloud dashboard, offline queue
- [Solo Ethernet](https://lyraenterprise.co.in/products/solo-ethernet-vending-machine): ₹26,500 — as Solo WiFi but wired LAN

## Rental plans (monthly, ex-GST)

IoT WiFi (Solo WiFi), IoT Ethernet (Solo Ethernet) and RFID (Solo RFID) sanitary napkin vending machines are available on monthly rent. Plans are priced by napkin capacity per fill; 18% GST is added.

- 25-napkin capacity: ₹999 per month
- 50-napkin capacity: ₹1,499 per month
- 100-napkin capacity: ₹1,999 per month
- Included in the rent: installation, regular servicing, replacement of parts, breakdown support, over-the-air software updates, and live monitoring with low-stock and fault alerts on the Lyra website
- Not included: napkin refills, which must be purchased from Lyra
- Minimum agreement: 3 years
- Rent starts from month 1. At signing (per machine): refundable security deposit of ₹4,999 plus the first month's rent, or 3 months' rent in advance with no deposit; 18% GST is added to both
- The signing amount can be paid online on the rental page (UPI, cards, net banking via Razorpay)
- Recharge plans after month 1 (per machine, on rent, plus 18% GST): Monthly (1 month), Quarterly (3 months, 5% off), Yearly (12 months, 10% off). Recharge online at https://lyraenterprise.co.in/rental/recharge with the rental code and registered mobile
- Reminders 7 days and 1 day before rent runs out; 7-day grace period after the due date, then UPI/RFID vending is paused until rent is recharged
- Details and rental enquiry form: https://lyraenterprise.co.in/sanitary-napkin-vending-machine-on-rent

## Incinerator models (prices ex-GST)

- [Lyra Micro](https://lyraenterprise.co.in/products/lyra-micro-incinerator): ₹13,000 — 1–5 napkins per 30-minute cycle, up to 80 per 8-hour day
- [Lyra Mini](https://lyraenterprise.co.in/products/lyra-mini-incinerator): ₹16,000 — 5–15 napkins per cycle, up to 240 per 8-hour day
- [Lyra Maxi](https://lyraenterprise.co.in/products/lyra-maxi-incinerator): ₹40,000 — 25–50 napkins per cycle, hospitals and large campuses

## Quick facts

- Prices exclude 18% GST and freight; machines ship pan-India from Chennai, typically 3–7 business days in transit.
- Warranty: 1 year against manufacturing defects; defective or damaged units can be returned within 10 days of delivery.
- All vending machines run on 230V AC mains and dispense one napkin per transaction.
- Notable customers: Larsen & Toubro (25 IoT machines at Manapakkam, Chennai), TVS Motor, Saint-Gobain, Parker Hannifin, Ashok Leyland, ISRO, Vels University, Stella Maris College.
